item.title: PTTT partners with Centrica
item.description: PTT International Trading Pte Ltd and Centrica LNG Company Ltd have signed a long-term LNG sale and purchase agreement for a period of 10 years.

item.title: Saipem awarded offshore EPCI contract by QatarEnergy LNG
item.description: Saipem, in partnership with Offshore Oil Engineering Co. Ltd, has been awarded an offshore EPCI contract by QatarEnergy LNG for the COMP5 package of the North Field Production Sustainability Offshore Compression Complexes project.

item.title: Baker Hughes to supply liquefaction equipment for Commonwealth LNG
item.description: Baker Hughes has received a full notice to proceed from Technip Energies on behalf of Commonwealth LNG to supply primary liquefaction equipment for Commonwealth LNG’s 9.5 million tpy export facility.

item.title: GTT receives order from HD KSOE
item.description: GTT has received an order from HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering for the tank design of a new LNG carrier.

item.title: Equinor provides status update for Snøhvit Future project
item.description: Equinor has released updated estimates for progress and costs for the Snøhvit Future project.

item.title: China’s 2025 LNG imports shift down: What comes next?
item.description: In our December regional report, Go Katayama, Kpler LNG Insight, explores why China’s LNG demand retreated in 2025 and what lies ahead for 2026.

item.title: Trinity Gas Storage reaches FID on Phase II expansion
item.description: Trinity Gas Storage, LLC has reached final investment decision on Phase II of its gas storage development project in East Texas.

item.title: New Fortress Energy extends forbearance agreement
item.description: New Fortress Energy Inc. has extended its forbearance agreement with representatives of the holders of its new senior secured notes due 2029 from 15 December 2025 to 9 January 2026.

item.title: Managing the pressure: LNG boil-off gas compression
item.description: In our December 2025 issue of LNG Industry, Daniel Patrick, Market Segment Manager – LNG & Hydrogen, Atlas Copco Gas and Process, highlights the various challenges that boil-off gas compressors face in LNG operations and explores how integrally geared compressors help to tackle them.

item.title: GAZ-SYSTEM considers potential of biomethane
item.description: GAZ-SYSTEM has launched preliminary market consultations concerning the planned purchase of biomethane for use in technological processes.
